title: 燃料電池直流轉換器
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討燃料電池極化、輸入紋波與升壓控制，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore fuel-cell polarization, input ripple and boost regulation, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。本課不涵蓋氫氣管線、燃料供應啟停或化學操作；堆疊限制以供應商資料及專業試驗為準。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Hydrogen piping, fuel-system startup and chemical operations are outside scope; stack limits require supplier data and professional tests.

stages.title: 堆疊與極化
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成堆疊與極化；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete stack and polarization through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 讀取極化曲線：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Read polarization curves: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解讀取極化曲線，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand read polarization curves through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 在示意 V–I 曲線標出三區，計算每點 P=VI 而非只看電壓。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Mark three regions on an illustrative V–I curve and calculate P=VI at each point. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 在示意 V–I 曲線標出三區，計算每點 P=VI 而非只看電壓。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Mark three regions on an illustrative V–I curve and calculate P=VI at each point. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「讀取極化曲線」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把燃料電池極化、輸入紋波與升壓控制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If read polarization curves disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of fuel-cell polarization, input ripple and boost regulation behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「讀取極化曲線」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for read polarization curves, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 讀取極化曲線：原理
knowledge.text: 活化、歐姆與濃差損失在不同電流區間主導。
knowledge.textEn: Activation, ohmic and concentration losses dominate different current regions.

knowledge.title: 讀取極化曲線：證據
knowledge.text: 在示意 V–I 曲線標出三區，計算每點 P=VI 而非只看電壓。
knowledge.textEn: Mark three regions on an illustrative V–I curve and calculate P=VI at each point.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：堆疊 100 V 供 20 kW 負載、轉換效率 95%，平均輸入 I=Pout/(ηVin)=210.5 A。若 Vin 下降到 80 V，同功率需 263.2 A，顯示把堆疊當理想電壓源會低估電流。 本課不涵蓋氫氣管線、燃料供應啟停或化學操作；堆疊限制以供應商資料及專業試驗為準。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 100 V stack supplies 20 kW at 95% converter efficiency, requiring I=Pout/(ηVin)=210.5 A. At 80 V the same output requires 263.2 A, showing why an ideal-voltage-source assumption understates current. Hydrogen piping, fuel-system startup and chemical operations are outside scope; stack limits require supplier data and professional tests.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「燃料電池直流轉換器」的「讀取極化曲線：建立模型」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源來源、導體、負載、回流與保護的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「微電網：守住晚高峰」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓模型的接線圖、電流方向、測點與時間戳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Read polarization curves: build the model” in “Fuel-cell DC converters”. Draw the source, conductor, load, return and protection boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Microgrid: Protect the Evening Reserve” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for isolated low-voltage wiring diagram, current direction, measurement points and timestamps, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.
